occurrences.subject: Trump administration

occurrences.checkable_against: JD Vance's October 8, 2026 remarks and PERM application records

occurrences.subject: Trump administration

occurrences.checkable_against: PERM regulations and JD Vance's October 8, 2026 statement

occurrences.subject: Trump administration

occurrences.checkable_against: Keith Sonderling's statement and federal investigation records concerning the named firms

occurrences.checkable_against: Microsoft statement on employee compensation and H-1B wage filings
occurrences.quote_span: "We pay our employees some of the highest compensation in the tech sector, and our wages are among the highest of all H-1B filings," the company said.

occurrences.checkable_against: White House schedule and National Medal of Technology and Innovation award records for October 8, 2026

occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Trump administration

occurrences.checkable_against: JD Vance's October 8, 2026 remarks
occurrences.quote_span: "They'll put an advertisement in a small-town newspaper. They'll go out there and say that 'We have advertised for a position with our company, and nobody is responding to it.' And they will use that lack of response to then go and replace American workers with what is effectively foreign indentured servants," Vance claimed.
occurrences.speaker: JD Vance
occurrences.subject: Trump administration

occurrences.checkable_against: Keith Sonderling's October 8, 2026 statement and U.S. Labor Department PERM records
occurrences.quote_span: US Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling accused those tech firms of abusing the program — the Permanent Labor Certification Program (PERM) — that had so far been a legal pathway for workers to apply for green cards.
occurrences.speaker: Keith Sonderling
occurrences.subject: Trump administration

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Labor Department PERM suspension order or announcement naming Cognizant, Infosys, Tata, Wipro, HCL, and Capgemini
occurrences.quote_span: "I am hereby suspending from the Permanent Labor Certification Program some of the largest IT outsourcing firms in the world, Cognizant, Infosys, Tata, Wipro, HCL, and Capgemini," US Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling said.
occurrences.speaker: Keith Sonderling
occurrences.subject: Trump administration

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Labor Department PERM suspension announcement of October 8, 2026

occurrences.subject: Trump administration

occurrences.checkable_against: Microsoft statement responding to the October 8, 2026 PERM suspension
